name: Frankfurt (Rhein-Main-Neckar)
author: pierreggt
description: Fused map of Frankfurt, Wiesbaden, Mainz, Mannheim, Heidelberg, Ludwigshafen, Karlsruhe and the surrounding Rhein-Main and Rhein-Neckar towns, Germany, from Frankfurt Airport and Karlsruhe/Baden-Baden Airport across the joined S-Bahn Rhein-Main and S-Bahn RheinNeckar networks. Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022). Real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchor Wiesbaden, Mainz, Karlsruhe and 14 other municipalities; Frankfurt and Mannheim, the two largest cities on this map, rely on a POI-density gravity model.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online) for Wiesbaden/Mainz/Karlsruhe and satellite towns, gravity model for Frankfurt and Mannheim, OSM, Overture Maps
